references.text: Describes the wicked's poison as that of a serpent, like a deaf viper that closes its ear
Speaks of the evil having the poison of serpents under their lips, using the same imagery of poisonous snakes
Mentions the venom of snakes and vipers as a symbol of evil and judgment
Uses the imagery of snake eggs and vipers to describe the wickedness of the ungodly
Paul quotes from the Psalms and describes human wickedness with the poison of serpents under their lips
Dan is compared to a serpent by the roadside and a viper, using the same imagery of poisonous snakes
